Request from BOCC Human Resources: 'current classification and pay plan listing every job title with its assigned pay grade (B80/B76/EX/BCO/FR/BSE/BE)'.

Individual salaries (payroll register) for BOCC employees are not published online. Request: 'Payroll/position roster as of 10/1/2026 with job title, department, pay grade/step and annual rate (names may be redacted as appropriate)'.

Salaries of department heads (CFO, Chief HR Officer, Chief Technology Officer, Chief Procurement Officer, Chief Risk Officer, Chief Communication Officer, Chief Infrastructure Officer, Deputy County Manager, County Attorney, directors) are not published; only the BCO/BSE/BE grade ranges are.

Emergency Services FR grades (FR-4..FR-13) are not mapped to ranks (Firefighter EMT, Firefighter Paramedic, Engineer, Captain, Battalion Chief) in any posted document. Request: 'Fire Rescue/EMS rank-to-FR-grade assignment and any certification/paramedic incentive pay schedule'.
